text: Before a language model sees your message,
it chops the text into tokens:
common chunks of letters, each turned into a number.
like, ess tee ar, eh double-you, and berry.
The model never sees the individual letters.
So when you ask how many arrs it has,
it's reasoning about chunks, not spelling.
Newer models often work around this,
but the letters were never what it saw.
